title: Virtual Compute: refund assessment handling scope
content:
## Scope and evidence

Virtual Compute refund assessment scope. This assessment applies to an existing customer-filed maximum-permitted refund request for the exact original payment, in status pending and decision none. The accountant verifies the request, original posted payment, exact allocated charge and completed correction, and synchronously records an approved eligibility review without moving funds or approving the customer signature. A positive assessment records decision eligible and assessed refund amount equal to the permitted refund amount; an unavailable or below-minimum amount permits no positive assessment. The filed request remains pending; its customer consent was established when it was filed. For this assessment action, evidence event reference and customer request reference identify that exact filed request, original source reference identifies its original posted payment, related evidence reference identifies the original primary charge paid by that payment, and posted correction reference identifies the exact preceding assisted credit for that charge. The created review retains customer request reference, the original payment as original source reference and the posted correction as related evidence reference. The selected payment has exactly one pending customer refund request in this package; the existing request names that original payment and its paid primary charge. An existing approved eligible assessment for that payment is read-only, including when the same request is repeated; this package creates no second eligible assessment for the payment. This immediate ACH package requires the original posted payment method to be ach; the original destination is represented by that exact payment reference.
